events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent, not a person. I'm acting for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components, and I can reset employee passwords. I don't have information about which underlying AI model I run on, and I can't tell you whether this chat is logged or who can view it.

If you'd rather speak to a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm. When you're ready, please send your employee ID and I'll start the password reset.
